findings.place: .github/workflows/app.yml:217 (step: Every table of B has a row; sub-step B13, design 6.3 step 14)
findings.what: The constant do block is opened and closed with a single dollar sign: psql ... -c 'do $ declare t text; ... end loop; end $'. A dollar quote is $$ or $tag$; a lone $ is a syntax error. Reproduced on PGlite (same parser): `do $ ... $` gives 'syntax error at or near "$"'; the same body with $$ or $do$ runs, and raises 'a public table has no row' on an empty table. So on GitHub the job migration-rehearsal is red at step 14 every time, and the steps after it (start the app on B, selfcheck, smoke) never run; REQ-120 criterion 3 and the trial of design 6.3 cannot pass. The developer proved no part of the job on Postgres (I13) and the ci-workflow finder cannot see this.
findings.fix: In the run line of that step replace the opening `do $ declare` by `do $do$ declare` and the closing `end $'` by `end $do$'` (the inner $s$, $f$, $m$ tags stay; nothing inside contains $do$). Keep it one psql -c with ON_ERROR_STOP and no `||`. TEST-DESIGNER's REHEARSAL_STEPS then takes this text.

issues.text: F1: fix the step 14 dollar quote in .github/workflows/app.yml (CODE-FIXER through ORCH); the file then passes steps 3 and 4 again. Nothing else needs a code change for a PASS.

The audit writer must run on a platform transaction (design 4.11): the SELECT policy of audit_log gives rows to app.role platform only, so appendAudit on a q already switched to tenant settings would read no previous hash and start a second chain from 64 zeros. No M2.2 route does that (no tenant route exists); REQ-117 must audit before switchToTenant or the writer needs a guard. Suggest ORCH records it for the REQ-117 design.

Every failed login, including one for an unknown e-mail, writes one append-only audit row and one login_failures row; only the per-address limit (10 per 15 minutes) bounds the growth, and audit_log has no cleanup by design. Slow growth against the size of the free database is possible from many addresses. Low; ORCH may open a defect or accept it with a note in the runbook (quality-bar section 6, item 6).

TEST_CONFLICT A6 from FRONTEND-DEV (one sai:kk region on each new page versus 'no region' in the design's test edit A6) needs ORCH's answer before TEST-DESIGNER edits PB-6; by my reading the pages are right (the rule 'data-lang kk outside a kk region' is red otherwise).

Not proved here and left to the GitHub run: pg.js transaction with the COMMIT limit, the row-lock races AUTH-RACE-1..4, RLS and grants on Postgres 17, the uat-login success path on Linux. Until F1 is fixed the rehearsal job cannot show any step after step 14.
